title: "Writing blockage or endless revision"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Diagnose

Is the blockage question, argument, evidence, structure, feedback, sentence production or an undefined standard?

## Do now

1. Name the reader's question.
2. Write the bounded claim, evidence, warrant and boundary.
3. Create paragraph-function headings before prose.
4. Label gaps rather than inventing content.
5. Choose the review stage and acceptance tests.
6. Freeze optional refinements after the gate.

## Before asking

Bring the draft state, argument map, known gaps, checks completed and one to three review questions.

## Stop or change route

Stop copy editing when the argument is unstable. Stop reopening design when submission checks pass and no material defect is recorded.

## Evidence of unstuck

A bounded section or review package exists, passes the stage rubric and has a clear next reviewer or gate.

Use the [argument map](../templates/synthesis-argument-map.qmd), [review cover note](../templates/supervisor-review-cover-note.qmd) and [good-enough rubric](../checklists/good-enough-rubric.qmd).
